messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re:
parts:
Fang, these aren't "slides" per se, but you might consider looking at the Examples section of the NIMBLE website:
https://r-nimble.org/examples

Or, perhaps, Chapter 2 "Lightning introduction" of the NIMBLE User Manual:
https://r-nimble.org/html_manual/cha-lightning-intro.html

Hope this helps!  And good luck with your presentation.

Daniel
